kind: Read-only offline source/archive comparison; no build, unit test, timing or VM action
limits: Compares recorded source and archived source bytes with the current checkout; does not independently rebuild binaries or establish binary/source derivation.
Live runs use their recorded scopes and instrumentation; this report does not pool results or make performance claims.
Unit fixture and documentation edits outside each live source manifest are not represented as live-tested inputs.
Prepared observation copies are intentional and checked byte-for-byte by static in-memory diff reconstruction; prepare.py and patch were not executed.
production_selector: include/ and kernel_module/: *.c, *.inc, *.h, *.S, *.def and Makefile, excluding hidden paths and *.mod.c; matches private provider prepare.py selector

prepared.private_manifest_exception: Generated provenance marker; not a production source file.
